$comment: Every band and weight the badges use. Rebased for the Sep 2026 scale: at 60% portfolio capacity utilization the old cut-offs put every vendor in the same bucket. The product badges exactly two metrics, Vendor Score and Leakage Summary, so only those two bands render; the rest are here so a future badge has a home. dependency bands are the share of delivered work sitting with the largest single vendor.

employeeUtilization.$comment: A seat's utilization is drawn lognormally around its vendor's mean, with the scatter set per vendor by personality.utilizationSpread in vendors.json. overAt and underAt are the product's own thresholds.
